block_05_direct_answer.title: Direct answer
block_05_direct_answer.body_html: Escrow and permit checks help confirm that an off-plan project follows the required framework. For low-down-payment buyers, verify project registration, escrow or payment details where relevant, current status, required approvals and the identity of the contracting developer. Use current official records where available and never treat a sales document alone as proof of regulatory status.

items.answer: Live availability can only be confirmed from a current sales or inventory source. Confirm whether the unit is open, held, reserved or subject to another buyer process before making decisions around its advertised availability.
items.question: How can I verify current availability?

items.answer: Developer track record is best judged through completed projects and delivery behaviour. Assess whether construction stage, project updates and visible execution support the payment schedule and handover expectations being marketed.
items.question: How should I assess a developer's track record?

items.answer: The best developer questions test the facts behind price, delivery and the contract. Understand defect handling, warranties, building management and owner support because developer quality continues to matter after completion.
items.question: What questions should I ask the developer?

items.answer: A stated handover date should be checked against the project’s actual progress and documents. A sales timeline is being treated as firm without support from project progress and contract wording. Treat marketing dates as indicative until the relevant project documents and current progress support them.
